title: The first user ahead on day one
note: The tool that helps one person, alone, at once - the only bar that matters for adoption.

title: Phase 0: a reproducible environment
note: A pinned toolchain; empty crate stubs build.

title: Phase 1: load a workspace and list what is in it
note: The extraction pipeline wires together, on a tiny fixture kept for ever.

title: Phase 2: real connections, not text
note: References resolved semantically into an adjacency list.

title: Phase 3: identity from structure
note: Four checks: determinism; a renamed local changes nothing; a renamed item keeps its hash; one changed line cascades up and nowhere else.

title: Phase 4: one shared store, a warm daemon
note: Four tables: hash to form and references, hash to source span, name to hash, the reverse index.

title: Phase 5: graft - the round trip
note: A closure walked, emitted verbatim, built and tested: identity survived the trip and the output runs.

title: Phase 6: sync by difference
note: Two stores compared; only what differs moves.

title: Phase 7: graft something real, and write down what breaks
note: One function out of a small real crate; the deliverable is the honest list of gaps.

title: Changing things while they run
note: The index of where things live; changes classified beforehand.

title: The reach-against-change engine
note: Conflicts resolved by computing what a consumer reaches against what changed; the same engine for impact and for live-swap classes.

title: Conjuring a whole project
note: Many entry points; the full rz verbs; a real transport in place of local sync.

title: Rhizoid's repositories under this organization
note: Offered by the author; a transfer changes their addresses (its design log's site is tied to its organization's name), so it is to be done deliberately. The Rhizome lens gathers Rhizoid where it is meanwhile.

title: The warm base and confinement
note: The genome process; a shoot's world derived from its closure.

title: The manifesto
note: Stop managing software. Start growing it. - the whole idea, for a reader who does not write software (MANIFESTO.md).

title: Hypha's roadmap
note: The first milestone in eight phases, with its decisions and what it leaves out (ROADMAP.md).

title: Hypha grown from its own graph
note: The fixpoint: built from the graph, it re-emits itself to the same hash.

title: Views: everything visible, nothing present
note: The filesystem view; the editor that navigates relationships; values beside the code.
